newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's CTC denies VTR merger snags.
newsitem.headline: Chile's CTC denies VTR merger snags.

text.p: Chile's largest telecom Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile denied Friday it hit problems in merger talks with rival VTR.
VTR is 40 percent owned by SBC Communications.
"The sides will keep talking and negotiating this week and I suppose they will continue until the issue is closed," CTC's general manager Jacinto Diaz told reporters.
"I don't know who invented this (the differences). There is no problem."

Chilean media have reported that Spanish company Telefonica de Espana, which owns 43 percent of CTC, had demanded that SBC sell its VTR stake if the merger goes ahead. The reports said SBC may receive $400 million for its sharehlding, which it bought two years ago.
Talks on the pact are being carried out directly by the Spanish firm's international division, Telefonica Internacional and the Luksic group, which controls VTR.
Diaz said there was no closing date for the talks, which became public two months ago.
